The fresh full-response digest equals the registered source revision's digest. The iterator protocol explicitly contrasts a continuing yield call with the false result when the loop terminates. The false value is a result of the range protocol, and a break that exits only an inner construct need not end the outer range loop. The range expression is a valid iterator function, an invocation of yield executes the loop body, and a break terminates that range loop. The statement does not prescribe an implementation's diagnostic or panic behavior for a subsequent prohibited call to yield. A break of the range loop and a nested switch break are different control transfers. This does not cover abrupt panic paths.
